$comment: Hook wiring. These two entries are the difference between a design document
and a working constraint: everything the agents are told about review and
persona drift is a request until something outside them refuses to advance.
persona-drift-check runs after the session log is appended to, so a
vocabulary breach fails the step it happened on rather than being noticed
qa-review-gate runs on Stop and SubagentStop, which is where an agent would
otherwise declare itself finished. It is staged: a stopping subagent is held
to what its role must have produced (user-agent: a valid session log;
qa-agent: the candidates; and so on), from tools/pqa/roles.py, and the run
it guards is the one `pqa seal` marked active.
The checks are `pqa`, shared with the Codex and Antigravity adapters; see
